title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

Launch Your Career in Data, Property & Finance

Salary: £26,500 per annum
Hybrid Working: 3 Days Office / 2 Days Home
Full Time, Permanent
Monday to Friday | 8:30am - 5:00pm

Are you naturally analytical, highly organised, and passionate about working with data?

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join a growing team where you'll gain hands-on experience interpreting complex datasets, conducting research, and uncovering valuable insights. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career in data analysis, property, or financial research.

No previous experience in business rates is required. Full training will be provided for candidates with strong numerical skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.

The Role

As a Data Analyst, you'll be responsible for researching businesses, analysing data, and identifying opportunities through detailed investigation and reporting. You'll work closely with internal teams to ensure accurate and insightful information is gathered and presented.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse large datasets using Microsoft Excel.
  • Research businesses and commercial properties using a variety of online resources and databases.
  • Interpret complex information and identify key trends and opportunities.
  • Learn and apply specialist knowledge relating to property and financial data.
  • Make informed decisions based on your research and analysis.
  • Produce detailed yet concise reports and summaries for internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records and data management processes.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to support business objectives.

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Excellent numerical and analytical ability.
  • A strong academic background.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret data and make confident decisions.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in using multiple systems, databases, and online research tools simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach and eagerness to learn.

Desirable

  • Experience working with data, reporting, or research.
  • An interest in property, finance, or commercial markets.
  • Previous analytical, administrative, or data-focused experience.

What's on Offer?

Salary of £26,500

28 days holiday plus bank holidays

Hybrid working with 2 days per week from home

Company pension scheme

Free parking

Casual dress code

Full training and ongoing support

Clear progression and career development opportunities

Friendly, collaborative, and supportive working environment

Who Would This Suit?

This role would be ideal for graduates or candidates with backgrounds in:

  • Mathematics
  • Economics
  • Finance
  • Business Studies
  • Geography
  • Data Analytics
  • Real Estate or Property

It would also suit individuals with strong analytical skills looking to transition into a data-focused career.

Ready to start your career in data analysis?

Apply today and join a team that will support your development while giving you the opportunity to build valuable analytical, research, and commercial skills.
